mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS "total", count(*) FILTER (WHERE cntc_stat_cd NOT IN ('HOLD','CTRT')) AS "inProgress", count(*) FILTER (WHERE cntc_stat_cd='ITVW') AS "interviewScheduled", count(*) FILTER (WHERE cntc_stat_cd NOT IN ('HOLD','CTRT') AND input_psbl_dt<=#{nextMonthStart}) AS "availableByNextMonthStart", count(*) FILTER (WHERE cntc_stat_cd NOT IN ('HOLD','CTRT') AND coalesce(last_cntc_dt,reg_dttm::date)<#{overdueBefore}) AS "overdueContact" FROM tb_hr_cand
